function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT pl.purchase_line_id, pl.sku, pl.qty, pl.unit_price_orig, pl.contract_unit_price, pl.fx_rate, pl.unit_cost_cad, pl.amount_cad, v.vendor_name FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id WHERE pl.vendor_invoice_no = 'MRP-88213' AND pl.period = '2026-09'","purpose":"Check purchase lines for duplicate invoice"}
